title: HideEnchant
description: A lightweight and performance-friendly Spigot/Paper plugin to easily hide all enchantment glints and lore from your items!
body:
# 🛡️ Hide Enchants

A lightweight and straightforward Spigot/Paper plugin that allows players to hide or show enchantments on their items. It hides both the shiny enchantment glow (glint) and the enchantment list from the item's lore, making your items look clean while keeping their active enchantments!

---

## ✨ Features
* 🔮 **Enchantment Toggle:** Easily hide or reveal enchantments on the item you are holding.
* ⚡ **Performance Friendly:** Extremely lightweight with no background tasks or lag.
* 🔒 **Permission Support:** Control who can use the command.

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/hideenchants` | Toggles the visibility of enchantments (glint & lore) on the item in your main hand. | `hideenchants.use` |

---

## 🛠️ Supported Versions
* **API:** Spigot / Paper 1.16.5 to 1.21.4+
